response.sql: WITH driver_totals AS (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS points_total, AVG(CASE WHEN laps GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(laps AS REAL) END) AS average_laps FROM results WHERE grid >= 12 GROUP BY driverId) SELECT AVG(points_total) AS average_points_total, AVG(average_laps) AS average_average_laps FROM driver_totals
